# appdimens-qt

> AppDimens for Qt 5.12+ and Qt 6: QML singleton `AppDimens` with the 172 family tokens as reactive functions (`width: AppDimens.sdp(120)`, factors at `AppDimens.factors.sdp`), C++ `ad->sdp(16)` / `AppDimens::sdp(16)` / `16_sdp`, per-window `DimensScope`, Widgets `AppDimens::Scope` with responsive Qt Style Sheets (`padding: 16sdp`), C++ literals (`16_sdp`), per-monitor fractional DPR, DPI, rotation. Windows, macOS, Linux, Android, iOS, embedded. Version 3.2.0.

- [README](README.md) · [Guide](docs/GUIDE.md) · [Skill](skills/appdimens-qt/SKILL.md)
- Core: `include/appdimens/appdimens.h` (shared C99 core) · binding: `include/appdimens/appdimens_qt.hpp`
- Hub: https://github.com/bodenberg/appdimens

Family (same tokens and math): appdimens-dynamic (Android), appdimens-sdps/ssps (XML), appdimens-kmp, appdimens-ios, appdimens-flutter, appdimens-react-native, appdimens-web, appdimens-net-binding (.NET), appdimens-qt, appdimens-gtk, appdimens-lvgl, appdimens-roku, appdimens-py, appdimens-games — https://github.com/bodenberg/appdimens · agent skills: https://github.com/bodenberg/appdimens-skills
